Choosing between AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 usually comes down to fit, features, and price. Apple is also apparently developing AirPods with cameras and Visual Intelligence, but the earliest they might launch is 2027, meaning you could be waiting a long time.

AirPods 4 focus on comfort and value, with options to choose from

The AirPods 4 use an open design, making them a solid recommendation if you don't like in-ear tips. Our AirPods 4 review found that the redesigned shape is comfortable to wear without sacrificing everyday convenience.

The $129 model comes with Apple's H2 chip, personalised Spatial Audio, and up to five hours of listening time. However, it lacks Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, and wireless charging.

The $179 model adds useful Active Noise Cancellation without needing to seal the ear canal, along with Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

The open design still lets in more ambient sound, so ANC performance will take a hit on planes and public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 offer the most complete feature set

AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249 from Apple, though Amazon frequently runs discount promotions. Their foam-blend ear tips deliver stronger bass and noticeably better noise cancellation. Apple rates them at up to eight hours with ANC on, compared to just four hours for the AirPods 4 with ANC.

They can measure heart rate during workouts, and support Apple's hearing test, hearing aid, and hearing protection features. Our AirPods Pro 3 review found that their workout heart rate readings were broadly consistent with Apple Watch data.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 adds custom EQ to both models, while the AirPods Pro 3 gains extra advantages from its heart rate sensor and updated charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, AirPods with Visual Intelligence were revealed early in a video hidden inside the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate. The clip appears to show someone using Siri with Visual Intelligence to remember details about a book, operated through AirPods with a camera, leading to speculation that the product could be launching soon.

However, follow-up reporting suggested otherwise. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that AirPods with cameras are still expected to arrive in 2027. The B790 model seen in the video is reportedly a version of the AirPods Pro 3 that has been dropped from Apple's 2026 roadmap. Apple is continuing to develop the newer B798 model.

Which AirPods should you actually buy?

If price is your top priority and you don't need noise cancellation, go with the $129 AirPods 4. If you really prefer the open fit, go with the AirPods 4 with ANC.

Beyond that, the AirPods Pro 3 remain the best choice, especially when Amazon discounts them to a price close to the AirPods 4 with ANC. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, heart rate sensing, and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods pricing

  • AirPods 4 ($99, originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC ($148.99, originally $179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, originally $249)

Only wait if Visual Intelligence is absolutely essential to you. If you need new earphones today, waiting over a year means you'll miss out on stronger ANC, better battery life, and other practical benefits in the meantime, all for a feature that hasn't even been announced yet.

Otherwise, just buy based on what you need today. Current AirPods with discounts already meet the practical needs of most buyers, and future models with cameras will likely cost more, or at launch will sell at prices close to their original retail.
